# How much of your revenue could walk out the door with one client?

> Paste an invoice export and see each client's share of revenue, your top-three share, whether dependence is rising, and whether you survive losing your biggest client. Free, runs in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
